title: IGADA-IoT: IoT Sensor Energy Optimization in Wireless Sensor Networks Driven by Automatic Data Augmentation
abstract: arXiv:2605.27397v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In wireless sensor networks (WSNs), data augmentation is a novel method to improve sampling-frequency decision performance, thereby enabling energy optimization for IoT (Internet of Things) sensors. However, existing methods rely on a single generator and empirically determined quantities, failing to establish a mapping between dynamic information gaps and multiple generators, and overlooking the heterogeneity of generated samples. Moreover, an evaluation and a closed-loop method that jointly consider the information gap and the model performance are lacking. To address these issues, we propose an information gap-guided IoT sensor automatic data augmentation framework (IGADA-IoT) with hierarchical multi-generator collaboration and scheduling over multiple rounds. translated_title: IGADA-IoT：基于自动数据增强的无线传感器网络中物联网传感器能耗优化
translated_abstract: 在无线传感器网络（WSN）中，数据增强是一种提升采样频率决策性能的新方法，从而实现物联网（IoT）传感器的能耗优化。然而，现有方法依赖单一生成器和经验确定的数量，未能建立动态信息差距与多个生成器之间的映射，并忽视了生成样本的异质性。此外，目前还缺乏一种能够同时考虑信息差距和模型性能的评估与闭环方法。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种信息差距引导的物联网传感器自动数据增强框架（IGADA-IoT），该框架在多个轮次中采用分层多生成器协作与调度机制。通过联合利用不同生成器的能力来缩小信息差距。在IGADA-IoT中，分层多生成器协作与调度策略……
tldr: 提出了一种信息差距引导的物联网传感器自动数据增强框架IGADA-IoT，通过分层多生成器协作与调度机制缩小动态信息差距，实现无线传感器网络中物联网传感器的能耗优化。
en_tdlr: We propose IGADA-IoT, an information gap-guided automatic data augmentation framework with hierarchical multi-generator collaboration and scheduling across multiple rounds, to narrow dynamic information gaps and optimize IoT sensor energy consumption in wireless sensor networks.
